name: Brax
why: A German trouser house that treats fit systems as the product; chinos and five-pockets in engineered stretch cloths, sold through independents.
origin: Leineweber, Herford, Germany, 1888 — a trouser specialist that built out into full sportswear and still leads with the leg.
opview: The house sells the fit before the fabric: named leg shapes carried season to season so a customer buys the same trouser again.

onething.n: verified — direct product page, $198. Cadiz is the house's straight-fit five-pocket and the clearest statement of what it does

notes.forg: named fit systems — modern, regular, relaxed, slim, straight — carried consistently across the range
notes.synth: engineered stretch cloths are the house competence: HI-FLEX, FUSION FLEX, ULTRALIGHT
notes.reach: large in Europe, barely known in the US, which is where this map is looking

cities: No US own retail established; reaches the US through specialty independents and its own US webshop
